justification: General blog articles stated rule numbers and clause citations a reader could act on for their own lot; now plain explanations with links to the property check. Shadow figures marked not served (tool off since #1449).

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: blog article copy
functions.input: static article text and tables in the blog pages
functions.output: explanations without rule values, linking to /check or the topic tool
functions.if_none: static content; nothing can be missing at runtime

break_it.scenario: reader applies an article setback to their own lot
break_it.what_happens: they plan with a value that does not apply to them
break_it.repro: read setback-requirements-nsw typical table on origin/main
break_it.how: values replaced with what the control depends on, plus a /check link

break_it.scenario: rewrite leaves an unescaped apostrophe in a string
break_it.what_happens: the page fails to build and the blog 404s
break_it.repro: npx tsc --noEmit on the blog files
break_it.how: two found and escaped; tsc clean on app/blog

break_it.scenario: link points at the switched-off shadow tool
break_it.how: agents told not to link it; grep shows no new shadow links

post_merge.manual_verify: open /blog/can-i-build-a-granny-flat-nsw and /blog/setback-requirements-nsw and read the tables

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any app/blog file or lib/blog-articles.ts has an open or unlisted typed figure
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main: 56 open figures across 18 blog files; after: 0, total 364 -> 307
